mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1, indicating strengthening economic demand, boosts consumer and business confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with positive GDPC1 growth, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, signaling a tightening monetary cycle, investors anticipate reduced borrowing capacity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances with FEDFUNDS above 4.5%, or walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly, when UNRATE falls below 6% and PAYEMS increases by > 200k over 3 months, signaling a strong labor market, S&P 500 forward returns are positively affected over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:strong labor markets boost consumer spending
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 40% of triggered instances, or joint proxy Rank IC < 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in INDPRO, indicating improved industrial production, enhances corporate earnings prospects, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher in periods of INDPRO growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When RSAFS exceeds its 6-month moving average, signaling increased retail sales, S&P 500 forward returns are positively affected over the next 5 trading days due to improved consumer sentiment.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of triggered instances, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly, when FEDFUNDS is below 2% and CPIAUCSL growth is below 2% YoY, signaling accommodative monetary policy and low inflation, S&P 500 forward returns are positively affected over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of triggered instances, or joint proxy Rank IC < 0.04 over any 2-year rolling window.

failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 50% of triggered instances, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.
